long_description:
Pause, unwind, and reset with 90 minutes of guided meditation and restorative yoga designed to bring balance to mind and body.

About this Event

Relax & Restore: Guided Meditation + Restorative YogaAn evening of guided meditation and restorative/yin yoga to quiet your mind and bring you back to center.
Join us for this special workshop, led by Nancy MacGregor, a 200-hour YTT-certified yoga instructor and mindfulness practitioner. For 90 minutes, you’ll be guided in meditation and relaxing, restorative poses to bring balance to your mind and body, and a peaceful serenity to wash over you.
Suitable for teenagers and adults. No experience necessary.

What to BringPlease bring a yoga mat. If you don’t have one, simply select the free yoga mat add-on when registering and one will be provided.
